title: Persist immutable draft clustering runs and ground command
description: Bounded current-corpus pipeline through accepted snapshot/algorithms/summaries, deterministic runId from corpus/model/config/pins, per-run unique clusterIds, complete model/preset/params/seed/versions/createdAt manifest, detached members/outliers/centroids/conceptlabels pending listening. lab semantic cluster --corpus --catalog --preset --output validates current canonical data and metadata; never changes publishedpointer. Atomic no-clobber run install, repeated samepacket reuses original createdAt; divergent content for sameID fails rather than overwrite. Empty/small inputs explicit unclustered validdraft, missingdependency nonzero not_evaluated. No UI/publication/customparams/queue/AWS. Tests first, focusedpytest plus immutableGherkin; supervisor reruns. Parent retains publication controls.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Supervisor review requires corrections before acceptance: ancestor-symlink escape, POSIX rename no-clobber race and ENOTEMPTY handling, quadratic alias lookup, duplicate clusters and unit-centroid validation. Register and rerun BDD after handoff. Ground draft only, no publication/listening approval. Terra must not use Kanbus or git; supervisor owns board/landing.
